To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the moment of inertia after the band crossing for the Lu isotopes is a smooth function of I, (2) the triaxiality of Lu-161,Lua-163,Lu164 is appreciably different from that of Lu-167, (3) the triaxially deformed band crossing is not a necessary condition for the band crossing in the Lu isotopes.

the triaxiality of Lu nuclei is not a constant, but changes with the total angular momentum and that the triaxially deformed band in Lu-167 is the only one which is triaxially de formed before and after the rotational band crossing.

the triaxial deformation of the core of Lu-161,LU-163,Lu -165 increases from -10 degrees to + 10 degrees after the band crossing while that of Lu-167 decreases from -10 degrees before the band crossing.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of the structure and dynamics of nuclei in the vicinity of A=160, where the yrast states in the odd-A Lu isotopic chain exhibit a remarkable change of the moment of inertia and triaxiality at high angular momenta.
the study of the triaxiality of yrast states in even-even and odd-mass Lu isotopes.
the study of nuclear structure in the region of the heaviest odd-A nuclei.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the yrast states in the odd-A Lu isotopic chains are well described by the particle-rotoreror model.

the band crossings in the yrast negative-parity bands in the odd-A Lu isotopic chain occur at the angular momenta I=9-11h, and that the band-crossing angular momenta are not correlated with the band-head spin values, but rather with the band-crossing moments of inertia.
, for the yrast bands of odd-A Lu nuclei, the triaxiality is not a significant effect, and the particle-rotors model is a good approximation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the triaxiality of yrast bands in odd-A Lu nuclei is not a smooth function of mass and angular momentum.
the yrast negative-parity states in the odd-A Lu isotopic chain are well described by the particle-rotored model with an axially symmetric core.
the yrast negative-parity bands of odd-A Lu are triaxial before the band crossing but become prolate after the crossing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the particle-rotovibrator model is a good description of the yrast negative-parity states in odd-A 161,163,165,Lu, but not so for odd-A 167,169,Lu.
triaxiality plays a crucial role in the yrast band of Lu isotopes.
, in the case of Lu-161, Lu-163, Lu-165 and to a lesser extent Lu-167, the triaxiality of yrast states is not constant and changes appreciably at the band crossing.
